content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Atlanta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific education and hours-worked prerequisites for the PMP credential. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your background against PMI standards at no charge before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's PMI-approved, instructor-led course delivered live online. Our Atlanta-based instructors teach project-management frameworks, risk, quality, and professional responsibility aligned to the PMP exam blueprint. Completion earns your official education certificate—required for PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and submit your application, including proof of your 35 contact hours and work experience. Pay PMI's exam fee directly to the Institute. Our team guides you through each form field and deadline to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center in the Atlanta area or online. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam when you feel ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout your three-year renewal cycle by attending training, speaking at conferences, or publishing in your field. Granite PM Academy's ongoing courses help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in project-management practice.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.

The credential strengthens your negotiating position for salary and advancement, and demand for experienced, credentialed project managers in the region remains consistently strong across these sectors.
